question: In the context of modern Indian history, the expression Bombay Plan (1944) was a proposal on:
solution:
The correct answer is __**economic development**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Bombay plan **was a **collection **of **recommendations **made by a **select group of prominent businessmen in Bombay**.
 
• It **was **for the **development **of the **post-independence economy of India**.
 
• The **first **and **second volumes **of this **plan **were **released in 1944 and 1945**, respectively.
 
• The **plan's main goals **were to **create economic balance **and quickly enhance the **standard of life **for the **majority of the population **by **doubling the current per capita income **within **15 years **of the **plan's implementation.**
 
• This **plan envisages **that the **economy could not grow **without **government intervention and regulation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Unlike urban **and **suburban municipalities**, **Panchayati Raj **is a **system of local self-**government for **villages in rural India**. It consists of the **Panchayati Raj Institutions**, which enable the realisation of **rural self-government.**
 
• A **department or separate unit **within a **department may be reorganised**, or distinct departments or units may **be merged**, leading to an **increase or decrease **in **the level of employee **duties and the **potential termination **of one or more **employee positions.**
 
• A **peaceful transition **or transfer of power is a concept important to **democratic governments **in which the leadership of a government peacefully hands over control of government to a newly-elected leadership.
